images.reliability_note: Standing SKILL caveats - a LOW score from this engine is NOT evidence of authenticity. Double-quantization periodicity is undetectable in principle when the secondary/primary quantization-step ratio is an integer (the SKILL calls this a fundamental, unavoidable blind spot of every DQ-histogram method, with detection accuracy near zero), and is substantially degraded when the image was re-saved at LOWER quality than its original. Content spliced from a never-compressed source and never itself re-encoded is undetectable by this module family entirely. COVERAGE GAP: excluding the SKILL's [ML] Pipelines C and D leaves this engine blind to non-aligned (block-grid-shifted) double JPEG compression and to the QF1=QF2 case, which the SKILL states are handled by no training-free technique in its corpus. Best candidate quantization table reproduces only 98.4% of pixels exactly (runner-up 98.0%); a clean single compression history normally reproduces near 100%. Treated as a confidence discount only - the SKILL marks this reading an unvalidated engineering extrapolation. Estimated quality factor is 100, in the regime where the Pipeline A.1 history gate was measured to stop discriminating: s falls to 15-22 at QF95, 3.2-7.3 at QF98 and 1.0-4.5 at QF100, overlapping the 1.02-45.93 range never-compressed content produces. The gate's verdict for this image should not be read as evidence either way about its JPEG history. PROVISIONAL CALIBRATION: no known-authentic reference scores were supplied. The SKILL states calibration to [0,1] is not specified in its corpus for this module, and the peak-prominence decision rule itself is the SKILL's own training-free substitute for an [ML] classifier it excludes - treat this probability as a rough ordering signal, not a validated likelihood.
images.reasoning: Engine reported raw_score=0.161055 - Pipeline B's mean strongest peak prominence across its usable frequencies - at confidence 0.9837, is_reliable=True. Block DCT: {'total_blocks': 16512, 'unsaturated_blocks': 16300, 'blocks_per_row': 96, 'blocks_per_column': 172}. Pipeline A.1 (gate, never scored) measured the JPEG-history feature s=193.2225 against t=2.0, verdict is_jpeg_derived=True from 959543 AC coefficients in R1 against 4966 in R2. Pipeline A.3 recovered QF=100 at an exact-pixel-match rate of 0.9837 (runner-up 0.9797); the file's own DQT marker independently says QF=74 (agrees=False, DC step 6). Pipeline B used 10 of 10 low-frequency positions, of which 10 carried a peak above the 0.05 prominence threshold, with per-frequency strongest prominences [0.5054, 0.1009, 0.1207, 0.1439, 0.0934, 0.1309, 0.1556, 0.087, 0.1521, 0.1207]. With the quantization-step normalisation disabled the same pipeline scores 0.0661.
images.mathematical_explanation: This engine measures double-quantization periodicity. Re-binning a coefficient population already quantized at step q_alpha into bins of a different step q_beta is a non-injective periodic remapping (Mahdian & Saic Eq. 4), so the coefficient histogram develops missing bins and periodic peaks that a singly-compressed histogram does not have. Pipeline B histograms each of 10 low-frequency DCT positions, takes the unit-normalised FFT magnitude, subtracts the trailing local minimum to strip the decaying trend (Eq. 5), and measures what peaks survive. For this image the surviving prominences were [0.5054, 0.1009, 0.1207, 0.1439, 0.0934, 0.1309, 0.1556, 0.087, 0.1521, 0.1207], averaging to raw_score=0.161055. The decisive caveat is that a null result proves nothing: the SKILL states that when the ratio of the two quantization steps is an integer, NO periodic artifact is introduced at all - a fundamental blind spot with detection accuracy near zero - and that the no-ML path additionally cannot see grid-misaligned splices or the QF1=QF2 case.
